title: Cycle 16: Predictive Model Pre-selection
weak_spots: Static default model ignored the new reliability scorecard on launch and provider switch
No cost-aware filtering for 'cheap' model selection
No opt-in/opt-out UI for predictive selection
No transparency when a model was auto-chosen
clade-build LEAN_BR_OUTPUT whitelist drifted from build.sh

next_options.name: Latency-aware routing
next_options.summary: Record observed request latency in ModelOutcome and include EMA latency in the ranking score (Longshot pattern).

next_options.name: Cross-provider failover
next_options.summary: Allow fallback chain and predictive selection to cross providers when the current provider is entirely unhealthy (Universal LLM client pattern).

next_options.name: Circuit-breaker cooldowns
next_options.summary: Replace binary unhealthyModels set with per-model cooldown timers and half-open recovery probes (llm-fallback-router pattern).

notes: Added TRIOS_E2E_DISABLE_KEYCHAIN=1 to stop keychain password dialogs from unsigned e2e test binaries.
